name: Chart View
tagline: A Dataverse view as a bar, column, pie, donut or line chart — grouped by a column, aggregated on the server.

limitations: The harness has no Web API, so the server route — one aggregate over the whole view — never runs here; the chart groups the fixture's rows in the browser, which is the same route a canvas app takes. The caption says so.
The harness has no metadata, so a Choice's option colours are not read; the chart uses its own palette. On a model-driven form the option colours from the column's option set win.

The fixture's Industry column holds its labels rather than its option values, because a fixture record cannot carry both. The chart keys and labels by the text it is given, which is what a text category does on a form.
Clicking a group sets the two outputs, which the harness shows in its property panel; nothing on the demo page consumes them.
